property_summary: After any successful or failed call to transferOwnership by the owner, ownership can never end up at address(0): the reference reverts a zero-address transfer, while the mutant silently sets owner to address(0) — the fuzzed parameter is mapped onto the {0, non-zero} boundary so the fuzzer reliably finds address(0).
change_summary: Remove the zero-address check so ownership can be transferred to address(0).
